kpis.monthly_trend_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', FILL_DATE) AS bucket, SUM(PLAN_PAID_AMOUNT) AS value FROM HEALTH_CARE.MAIN.PHARMACY_CLAIM GROUP BY 1), indexed AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bucket) - 1 AS idx, value FROM monthly) SELECT REGR_SLOPE(value, idx) AS month_slope, REGR_R2(value, idx) AS month_r2, COUNT(*) AS month_buckets FROM indexed;
kpis.yearly_trend_sql: WITH yearly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', FILL_DATE) AS bucket, SUM(PLAN_PAID_AMOUNT) AS value FROM HEALTH_CARE.MAIN.PHARMACY_CLAIM GROUP BY 1), indexed AS (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bucket) - 1 AS idx, value FROM yearly) SELECT REGR_SLOPE(value, idx) AS year_slope, REGR_R2(value, idx) AS year_r2, COUNT(*) AS year_buckets FROM indexed;
kpis.month_of_year_seasonality_sql: SELECT MONTH(FILL_DATE) AS grp, SUM(PLAN_PAID_AMOUNT) AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM HEALTH_CARE.MAIN.PHARMACY_CLAIM GROUP BY 1;

table_usage_series.series_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', ah.query_start_time) AS bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT ah.query_id) AS query_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ah.user_name) AS distinct_users, COUNT_IF(qh.query_type IN ('INSERT','UPDATE','MERGE','COPY','DELETE')) AS write_count FROM SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.ACCESS_HISTORY ah, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => ah.base_objects_accessed) obj JOIN SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.QUERY_HISTORY qh ON qh.query_id = ah.query_id WHERE obj.value:"objectName"::string = 'HEALTH_CARE.MAIN.MEDICAL_CLAIM_HEADER' AND ah.query_start_time >= DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
